subject: Re: Clarifying VAT liability & recovery timeline - Elm Holdings
messages:
From: Sophie Allen <sophie.allen@elmholdings.co.uk>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-10T09:21:00Z
Subject: Outstanding balance and VAT classification for INV-8342

Hi Dev / Monica,

Thanks for the earlier conversations. We’ve pulled the ledger and have an outstanding balance tied to invoice INV-8342 (dated 2026-08-01) for £147,320. Elm’s finance team is trying to finalise whether the supply is subject to UK VAT or treated under reverse charge rules — that impacts the amount our AP team will release.

Could you confirm: 1) Redwood’s VAT registration status for this contract, and 2) whether you can split the invoice into net and VAT lines (or provide a VAT certificate) so our AP system can process it?

If we can’t resolve classification by end of next week our internal pay run will push the payment into the following month and we’ll need a short recovery plan.

Attachments: INV-8342.pdf

Regards,
Sophie Allen
Head of Finance, Elm Holdings
accounts-payable@elmholdings.co.uk
[Attachment: INV-8342.pdf (PDF)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Allen <sophie.allen@elmholdings.co.uk>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Outstanding balance and VAT classification for INV-8342

Hi Sophie — thanks for flagging this and for the clear ask. Short answers up front: Redwood is UK VAT-registered (VAT GB123456789). We can provide a VAT-compliant reissued invoice that separates net and VAT lines.

Next steps we propose: 
- I’ve attached a draft VAT certificate we issued for the contract and a clean copy of the invoice reissued as net + VAT. (Attachment: Elm_VAT_certificate_2025.pdf, INV-8342.pdf)
- If Elm confirms reverse charge applies, we will reissue a zero-VAT invoice with a reverse-charge note; if not, we will include VAT at the applicable rate.
- To avoid delaying your pay run, we can accept a staged payment plan: 60% now, remainder on confirmation of VAT treatment, with no late fees if payment lands within 30 days of confirmation.

Can you confirm which AP cut-off you’re targeting and whether accounts-payable@elmholdings can accept the reissued files?

Thanks — copying Marcus (revenue ops) to confirm the staged payment template and Monica for customer success visibility.

Best,
Dev Patel
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Elm_VAT_certificate_2025.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T08:32:00Z
Subject: Re: Outstanding balance and VAT classification for INV-8342

Team — looping in formally from collections/leadership. A few points: 
1) We should avoid automatic escalation to legal for a single VAT classification question; offer Elm a short remedy path.
2) Approve the staged payment plan but limit total exposure: 60/40 split with the second tranche due within 21 days of final VAT confirmation.
3) Offer a one-time admin credit of £3,000 if Elm wires the first tranche by Oct 31 to encourage immediate movement.

Dev — please prepare the reissued invoice and a clean payment plan doc with signature fields (DocuSign). Marcus — confirm the accounting entries and the GL code for the admin credit. Monica — please prepare a short customer note that explains the VAT wording we will use on the invoice (so Elm’s AP has the exact text).

I want a one-page summary (internal) by EOD Oct 22 so I can sign off on the credit and have CS send the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Dean <oliver.dean@elmholdings.co.uk>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Clarifying VAT liability & recovery timeline - Elm Holdings

Hi Marissa / Dev / Monica,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the credit offer — we appreciate it. Elm’s AP confirms they can accept reissued documentation and the VAT certificate you provided. We have two points: 
1) Please include the phrase “Reverse charge applies under Article 194(1)” on the reissued invoice if you are applying reverse charge; we will need that exact wording for our system.
2) We agree to the 60/40 staged payment. First tranche to be wired by 2026-10-29 and second tranche within 21 days of the VAT determination.

I’ve asked Sophie to start the wire and sign the DocuSign payment plan; she’ll loop you in once the wire is scheduled.

Regards,
Oliver Dean
Finance Director, Elm Holdings
[Signed: payment_plan_signature.pdf]
